memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in basic ADLs; uses a walking stick for outdoor ambulation; manages finances as an accountant.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (negative); recalls 1 of 3 items, clock draw normal.
falls: 0 falls in past 12 months; gait slow with cautious steps; timed up-and-go 14 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise supervised strength‑balance exercises and supportive footwear.
medicines: 9 regular medicines (polypharmacy) – request review against Beers criteria.
mood: Reports occasional low mood, denies hopelessness or suicidal thoughts.
carers: Carer: Son, Arjun Kumar.
goals: "I want to stay active enough to walk to the temple twice a week."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Walks short distances with stick; reports knee pain limiting stairs.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (stable).
falls: 1 fall in last 12 months (slipped on bathroom mat); gait unsteady; timed up-and-go 16 seconds (raised fall risk) – prescribe physiotherapy and non‑slip socks.
medicines: 10 regular medicines (polypharmacy) – request Beers review.
mood: Denies depression; reports frustration with mobility.
carers: Carer: Son, Arjun Kumar.
goals: "I wish to climb the temple steps without pain."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Weight‑bearing X‑ray both knees: mild joint space narrowing medial compartment, osteophytes; no fracture. Impression: Grade II osteoarthritis bilateral knees.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Uses walker for community ambulation; reports improved knee pain after physiotherapy.
cognition: Mini-Cog 2/5 (positive screen) – arrange detailed neuropsych assessment.
falls: 0 falls in past 12 months; gait with walker stable; timed up-and-go 14 seconds (borderline) – continue balance exercises.
medicines: 11 regular medicines (polypharmacy) – Beers review due.
mood: Reports occasional anxiety; denies depression.
carers: Carer: Son, Arjun Kumar.
goals: "I want to remember my grandchildren’s names and attend family gatherings."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Dr. Sita Rao, Ophthalmology, Narayana Nethralaya for dilated fundus exam to assess diabetic retinopathy. Please include visual acuity and OCT macula.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Ophthalmology report: Mild non‑proliferative diabetic retinopathy, both eyes; macula stable. Recommend annual fundus photography and tight glucose control. No laser needed at present.
